name: Exp_ForexProfitBoost_2nb
summary: This EA uses a custom indicator ForexProfitBoost_2nb, which combines two moving averages with Bollinger Bands, to generate buy and sell signals. It opens and closes positions based on the intersection of upper and lower indicator buffer signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels. The EA operates on a new bar basis and supports independent control of buy/sell opening and closing.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义指标ForexProfitBoost_2nb，结合两条移动平均线和布林带来生成买卖信号。根据指标上下缓冲区信号的交叉来开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。EA以新K线为基础运行，并支持买卖开仓和平仓的独立控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线与布林带的组合指标ForexProfitBoost_2nb，属于趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件为：当上轨信号缓冲区(Up)出现非空值且下轨信号缓冲区(Dn)前一值也为非空值时开多仓；当下轨信号缓冲区(Dn)出现非空值且上轨信号缓冲区(Up)前一值也为非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈（默认分别为1000和2000点），以及反向信号触发平仓（BUY_Close和SELL_Close逻辑）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数和百分比模式（LOT和MARGIN模式）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数，统一处理开仓和平仓逻辑。策略仅在新的K线出现时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a combination indicator ForexProfitBoost_2nb that merges two moving averages with Bollinger Bands, classifying it as a trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper buffer (Up) shows a non-empty value and the lower buffer (Dn) previous value is also non-empty; a sell signal is generated when the lower buffer (Dn) shows a non-empty value and the upper buffer (Up) previous value is also non-empty. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively), as well as reverse signal-triggered closing (BUY_Close and SELL_Close logic). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based percentage modes (LOT and MARGIN). Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for unified handling of opening and closing positions. The strategy only calculates signals on new bar formation rather than every tick, improving computational efficiency.

pros: 使用新K线机制避免逐tick重复计算，提高执行效率
买卖开仓和平仓逻辑独立可控，灵活性高
采用双均线与布林带组合，多维度确认趋势信号，减少假信号
包含止损止盈设置，具备基本风险控制
信号计算失败时有Recount机制自动重试，增强鲁棒性
pros_en: Uses new bar mechanism to avoid per-tick recalculation, improving execution efficiency
Buy/sell opening and closing logic is independently controllable, offering high flexibility
Combines dual moving averages with Bollinger Bands for multi-dimensional trend confirmation, reducing false signals
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings, providing basic risk control
Recount mechanism automatically retries on signal calculation failure, enhancing robustness
cons: 默认止损1000点和止盈2000点过大，在多数货币对上风险收益比不佳
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
依赖自定义指标ForexProfitBoost_2nb，指标不可用时无法运行且调试困难
布林带偏差仅设为1倍标准差，信号可能过于频繁导致过度交易
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large, resulting in poor risk-reward ratio for most currency pairs
No spread filter, potentially leading to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
No position check logic, possibly opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on the custom indicator ForexProfitBoost_2nb, which if unavailable prevents the EA from running and is hard to debug
Bollinger Band deviation set to only 1 standard deviation may generate too many signals leading to overtrading
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同向重复开仓
增加点差过滤和时间过滤，避免不利交易时段入场
将布林带偏差默认调至2，减少虚假信号频率
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter and session filter to prevent entries during unfavorable trading periods
Increase default Bollinger Band deviation to 2 to reduce the frequency of false signals

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，造成过度敞口
默认止损止盈点数过大，单笔交易风险较高
没有点差过滤机制，高点差环境可能导致不利成交
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause duplicate entries in the same direction, resulting in excessive exposure
Default stop-loss and take-profit points are very large, resulting in high risk per trade
No spread filter mechanism, high-spread environments may lead to unfavorable fills
